text:
elaine-fin: BrightMeter pilot invoice landed and the numbers don't line up with our token estimates. They billed 8,300 CUs for April but invoice total is $940. Our telemetry maps that usage to ~2.1M tokens which at our benchmark would be ~$2,100. Is CU defined differently?

sam-engineering: Pulled the trial usage export from the sandbox org. BrightMeter's 'CU' appears to be 'model-steps' with a model multiplier. Example rows from the CSV:```date,compute_units,model,avg_tokens
2026-05-02,2600,redwood-open-13,210
2026-05-09,2700,redwood-open-13,240
2026-05-20,3000,redwood-open-70,980```
toni-ops: We need a single normalized number: tokens per 1 CU (or CU per 1M tokens) so procurement can compare vendor prices to our per-token internal benchmarks. Can someone compute an approximate conversion using median seq len?
mike-purchasing: Asked BrightMeter rep for their CU->token conversion table and sample invoice line with SKU, unit price, qty (CU), discounts, and line total. Also requested they accept net30 on PO and remove auto-renew for pilot.
vivian-legal: Quick flag: their Master Subscription Agreement includes an annual price escalator of CPI + 6% and auto-renew by default. We should push for either a fixed pricing period for 12 months or a capped escalator (max 4%). Also require a 60-day renewal notice and audit rights for billing exports.
brightmeter-rep: brightmeter-rep: Sorry for the confusion our pilot pricing applied a promotional credit which didn't render clearly on that PDF. BrightMeter CU = 1 CU per 1k model-steps as a baseline, with model multipliers (e.g., x1.4 for very large models). For rough guidance: short (<=256 tokens) ~1 CU per 250 tokens, medium (257-1024) ~1 CU per 500 tokens, long (>1024) ~1 CU per 1000 tokens. We'll upload a normalized CSV (tokens_per_CU_by_model_and_bucket.csv) and a reconciled invoice line showing promo credit breakdown. Net30 is fine for enterprise PO; we can disable auto-renew for pilot contracts. For renewals we can offer a 6-month price lock and a 10% first-year commit concession.
billing-bot: billing-bot: brightmeter_pilot_invoice_apr2026.pdf uploaded (https://files.slack/brightmeter/brightmeter_pilot_invoice_apr2026.pdf)
sam-engineering: Quick back-of-envelope: if we assume medium mapping (500 tokens/CU) then 8,300 CUs -> ~4.15M tokens. At $0.5 per 1k tokens that's ~$2,075, so invoice at $940 implies a ~55% promotional credit or a lower unit price. Need their raw billing export to reconcile line-level discounts and any promo flags.
toni-ops: I requested the raw billing export + SKU mapping from BrightMeter billing team (cc: @brightmeter-rep). ETA ~48 hours. Will reconcile once received.
mike-purchasing: If they confirm net30 + price lock + a reasonable commit discount (10-15%) we can move to a small paid PO. I'll negotiate the commit band and ensure no auto-renew.
vivian-legal: Do not accept CPI+ escalators without a cap. Push for written cap (<=4%) or fixed pricing for 12 months. Add a 30-day invoice dispute window and quarterly billing export rights.
brightmeter-rep: brightmeter-rep: Uploaded normalized CSV and a sample_invoice_line.csv to the thread link. Granting billing export access to @toni-ops. I'll follow up on commit discount negotiation.
elaine-fin: Action items: @toni-ops get and reconcile raw billing export; @brightmeter-rep confirm sample invoice row + CSV (they said uploaded); @mike-purchasing negotiate commit discount and confirm net30/no-auto-renew; @vivian-legal to draft required contract language on escalator/notice/audit. Reopen thread when reconciled.
toni-ops: Export requested, ETA ~48h.
